G6.lang: Abel, second son of Adam and Eve, brother of Cain.

G7.lang: Abijah, (a) a king, son of Rehoboam, (b) founder of the eighth class of priests.

G8.lang: Abiathar, a priest in King David's time.

G10.lang: Abiud, son of Zerubbabel and father of Eliakim.

G11.lang: Abraham, progenitor of the Hebrew race.

G12.lang: the abyss, unfathomable depth, an especially Jewish conception, the home of the dead and of evil spirits.

G15.kort: I do that which is good
G15.lang: I do that which is good.

G18.lang: intrinsically good, good in nature, good whether it be seen to be so or not, the widest and most colorless of all words with this meaning.

G19.lang: intrinsic goodness, especially as a personal quality, with stress on the kindly (rather than the righteous) side of goodness.

G21.kort: I exult, am full of joy
G21.lang: I exult, am full of joy.

G22.lang: unmarried, of a person not in a state of wedlock, whether he or she has formerly been married or not.

G25.lang: I love, wish well to, take pleasure in, long for; denotes the love of reason, esteem.

G26.lang: love, benevolence, good will, esteem; plur: love-feasts.

G27.lang: loved, beloved, with two special applications: the Beloved, a title of the Messiah (Christ), as beloved beyond all others by the God who sent Him; of Christians, as beloved by God, Christ, and one another.

G29.lang: I impress (into my service), send (on an errand).

G32.lang: a messenger, generally a (supernatural) messenger from God, an angel, conveying news or behests from God to men.

G36.lang: lit: without family, hence: ignoble, base.

G37.lang: I make holy, treat as holy, set apart as holy, sanctify, hallow, purify.

G38.lang: the process of making or becoming holy, set apart, sanctification, holiness, consecration.

G40.lang: set apart by (or for) God, holy, sacred.

G48.lang: I cleanse, purify, either ceremonially, actually, or morally.

G50.kort: I do not know, am ignorant of
G50.lang: I do not know, am ignorant of (a person, thing, or fact), sometimes with the idea of willful ignorance.

G53.lang: (originally, in a condition prepared for worship), pure (either ethically, or ritually, ceremonially), chaste.

G55.lang: purely, sincerely, with pure motives, honestly.

G58.lang: market-place, forum, public place of assembly.

G68.lang: a field, especially as bearing a crop; the country, lands, property in land, a country estate.

G69.lang: I am not asleep, am awake; especially: I am watchful, careful.

G71.lang: I lead, lead away, bring (a person, or animal), guide, spend a day, go.

G73.lang: an (athletic) contest; hence, a struggle (in the soul).

G75.lang: I am struggling, striving (as in an athletic contest or warfare); I contend, as with an adversary.

G76.lang: Adam, the first man, the first parent of the human race.

G77.lang: without expense, for which nothing has to be paid.

G79.lang: a sister, a woman (fellow-)member of a church, a Christian woman.

G80.lang: a brother, member of the same religious community, especially a fellow-Christian.

G84.lang: out of sight, obscurely, inconspicuously, uncertainly, without certain aim.

G85.lang: I feel fear, lack courage, am distressed, troubled.

G91.lang: I act unjustly towards, injure, harm.

G96.lang: failing to pass the test, unapproved, counterfeit.

G101.lang: to be impossible; I am unable.

G102.lang: of persons: incapable; of things: impossible; either the inability, or that which is impossible.

G104.lang: always, unceasingly, perpetually; on every occasion.

G106.lang: unleavened, the paschal feast (a feast of the Hebrews); fig: uncorrupted, sincere.

G107.lang: Azor, son of Eliakim and father of Zadok, an ancestor of Jesus.

G109.lang: air, the lower air we breathe.

G114.lang: I annul, make of no effect, set aside, ignore, slight; I break faith with.

G120.lang: I lose heart, am despondent, am disheartened.

G123.lang: sea-coast, (sandy) beach; shore (of sea or lake), land.

G131.kort: I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood
G131.lang: I suffer from a continual flow (oozing) of blood.

G137.lang: Aenon; Eusebius and Jerome place this site 8 (Roman) miles south of Scythopolis near the Jordan.

G139.lang: a self-chosen opinion, a religious or philosophical sect, discord or contention.

G142.lang: I raise, lift up, take away, remove.

G153.kort: I am ashamed, am put to shame
G153.lang: I am ashamed, am put to shame.

G156.lang: a cause, reason, excuse; a charge, accusation; guilt; circumstances, case.

G163.lang: I take captive (in war); I subdue, ensnare.

G165.kort: an age, a cycle of time
G165.lang: an age, a cycle (of time), especially of the present age as contrasted with the future age, and of one of a series of ages stretching to infinity.

G166.lang: age-long, and therefore: practically eternal, unending; partaking of the character of that which lasts for an age, as contrasted with that which is brief and fleeting.

G170.kort: I am without a suitable opportunity
G170.lang: I am without a suitable opportunity.

G173.lang: a thorn-bush, prickly plant; a thorn.

G181.lang: disturbance, upheaval, revolution, almost anarchy, first in the political, and thence in the moral sphere.

G189.lang: hearing, faculty of hearing, ear; report, rumor.

G191.lang: I hear, listen, comprehend by hearing; pass: is heard, reported.

G192.lang: incontinence, intemperance (in wide sense), lack of restraint.

G198.lang: I learn carefully, inquire with exactness.

G202.kort: a hearer of, a listener to
G202.lang: a hearer of, a listener to.

G203.lang: (a technical word of Jewish use) foreskin, prepuce: used sometimes as a slang term by Jews, of Gentiles.

G207.lang: the Greek way of writing the Latin Aquila, a male proper name; the husband of Priscilla (Prisca), and a Jew, of a family belonging to (Sinope in ?) Pontus.

G208.kort: I annul, make of no effect, cancel
G208.lang: I annul, make of no effect, cancel.

G210.lang: unwilling, generally used where English would express by an adverb: unwillingly.

G211.lang: a phial or bottle of perfumed ointment, usually of alabaster.

G212.lang: boasting, show, arrogant display, ostentation; plur: occasions of ostentation.

G213.lang: a boaster, one who gives one's self airs in a loud and flaunting way.

G214.kort: I cry aloud, a clanging or clashing cymbal
G214.lang: I cry aloud, raise a war-cry; a clanging or clashing cymbal.

G216.lang: unable to speak or articulate; speechless.

G218.lang: I anoint: festivally, in homage, medicinally, or in anointing the dead.

G219.lang: the cockcrow, as a period of time, between midnight and 3 a.m.

G225.lang: truth, but not merely truth as spoken; truth of idea, reality, sincerity, truth in the moral sphere, divine truth revealed to man, straightforwardness.

G227.lang: unconcealed, true, true in fact, worthy of credit, truthful.

G228.lang: true (lit: made of truth), real, genuine.

G233.kort: I salt, sprinkle with salt, keep fresh and sound
G233.lang: I salt, sprinkle with salt (of sacrifices or of those who offer sacrifice), keep fresh and sound, and so acceptable to God.

G237.kort: from another quarter, by another way
G237.lang: from another place, by another way.

G242.lang: I leap, leap up; of water: I spring up, bubble up.

G243.lang: other, another (of more than two), different.

G245.lang: belonging to another person, belonging to others, foreign, strange.

G250.lang: aloes, the powdered fragrant aloe wood.

G256.lang: Alphaeus; apparently two persons, (a) father of Levi, and (b) father of James.
